build_world_model_loss: build a python module to compute the world model loss using MSE between predicted and actual next observations and rewards
create_policy_prior_loss: create a function that computes the policy prior loss by predicting next actions from current observations and previous actions
test_return_loss: test the n-step return loss function by comparing predicted returns against actual n-step returns from transition data
refactor_mse: refactor the MSE distance function to support weighted mean squared error for custom loss weighting
review_mbo_plosses: review the MBOPLosses dataclass to understand how world model, policy prior, and n-step return losses are configured together
